paragraphs.title: The Consultation and the Decision to Bring the Ark

answers: The captains of thousands and hundreds
easy.explanation: David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds and every leader.

answers: Their brethren, the priests, and the Levites
easy.explanation: David wanted to gather the Israelites who remained, along with the priests and Levites.
David said, “Let us bring again the ark of our God to us.”
easy.q: What did David want to bring?

answers: So they could join in bringing the ark
So they could drive the cart
So they could remain in their cities
medium.explanation: David included the priests and Levites in the gathering for the ark.
medium.q: Why did David propose gathering the priests and Levites?

medium.explanation: All the congregation said that they would do so.
medium.q: How did all the congregation respond to David’s proposal?

answers: The ark had not been sought
medium.explanation: David said, “We enquired not at it in the days of Saul.”
medium.q: According to David, what had not been done in the days of Saul?

answers: The decision involved both leaders and the people
The decision was made by Uzza alone
The decision was made without the people’s knowledge
challenge.explanation: David consulted the leaders, and then all the congregation agreed.
challenge.q: What does David’s consultation with the leaders and the congregation’s agreement show?

answers: It had been lost in battle
It had not been sought in Saul’s days
It had been kept in Jerusalem
challenge.explanation: David connected the plan with the fact that the ark had not been sought during Saul’s reign.
challenge.q: What reason did David give for bringing the ark again?

answers: The people considered the proposal proper
The people were afraid to disagree
The people did not understand the proposal
challenge.explanation: The congregation accepted the proposal because it seemed right to them.
challenge.q: What does the phrase “the thing was right in the eyes of all the people” indicate?

paragraphs.title: Gathering the People and Transporting the Ark

answers: From the house of Obed-edom to Jerusalem
From Shihor of Egypt unto the entering of Hemath
easy.explanation: David gathered Israel from Shihor of Egypt unto the entering of Hemath.
easy.q: From what region to what region did David gather Israel?

easy.explanation: David and Israel went to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.
The ark was carried in a new cart out of Abinadab’s house.
easy.q: What was the ark carried on?

medium.explanation: The text says that Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
They played before God with singing, harps, psalteries, timbrels, cymbals, and trumpets.
medium.q: How did David and Israel accompany the ark?

medium.explanation: The passage identifies Baalah as Kirjath-jearim.
medium.q: Where did David and Israel go to bring up the ark?

answers: The event involved only a small group
The gathering was intended to involve Israel broadly
The ark was moved only within one city
challenge.explanation: The boundaries from Shihor to Hemath emphasize the broad participation of Israel.
challenge.q: What does the wide geographic range of the gathering suggest?

challenge.explanation: The ark was transported in a public procession accompanied by singing and instruments.

answers: It came from Kirjath-jearim to be brought to David
It came from Egypt to Obed-edom
It came from Jerusalem to Saul
challenge.explanation: The people went to Kirjath-jearim to bring the ark to David.
challenge.q: Which detail identifies the ark’s source and its destination?

answers: David commanded him to do so
easy.explanation: Uzza reached out when the oxen stumbled.
easy.q: Why did Uzza put forth his hand to the ark?

answers: He drove the cart to Jerusalem
The LORD smote him, and he died
easy.explanation: The LORD smote Uzza, and he died there before God.

easy.q: What name was given to the place?

answers: He was displeased and became afraid to bring the ark
He sent all the people home
medium.explanation: David was displeased and asked how he could bring the ark home.
medium.q: How did David react to what happened?

answers: Why Uzza reached toward the ark
Why the people left the procession
medium.explanation: The stumbling oxen caused Uzza to put forth his hand to hold the ark.

answers: David became afraid to continue bringing the ark
Uzza ordered the journey to stop
medium.explanation: David feared bringing the ark home after the breach upon Uzza.
medium.q: What effect did Uzza’s death have on the journey?

answers: He moved from enthusiastic planning to fear
He moved from fear to complete confidence
He moved from indifference to destroying the ark
challenge.explanation: David first planned the joyful procession, but afterward feared bringing the ark to himself.
challenge.q: What change in David’s attitude is shown in this passage?

answers: The place was associated with the breach upon Uzza
A new cart was built there
challenge.explanation: The name commemorated the breach that came upon Uzza.

answers: Celebration changes into fear and sorrow
The ark changes into musical instruments
challenge.explanation: The joyful procession is interrupted by Uzza’s death and David’s fear.
challenge.q: What contrast appears between this passage and the preceding verses?

paragraphs.title: The Ark in Obed-edom’s House and the Blessing

easy.explanation: David carried the ark aside into the house of Obed-edom.
easy.q: Where was the ark taken after the incident?

easy.explanation: The ark remained there three months.
easy.q: How long did the ark remain in Obed-edom’s house?

answers: He removed it from the city
He blessed it and all that belonged to him
easy.explanation: The LORD blessed the house of Obed-edom and all that he had.
easy.q: What did the LORD do for Obed-edom’s house?

answers: David was afraid after Uzza’s death
The people refused to receive it
medium.explanation: David was afraid and therefore did not bring the ark home to himself.
medium.q: Why was the ark not brought into the city of David?

medium.explanation: The LORD blessed Obed-edom’s house during the three months.
medium.q: What happened while the ark remained with Obed-edom?

medium.explanation: The phrase includes all that belonged to Obed-edom.
medium.q: What does “all that he had” refer to?

answers: The house received blessing during the three months
The ark disappeared from the house
challenge.explanation: The passage ends by saying that the LORD blessed the house of Obed-edom.
challenge.q: What change occurred after the ark was moved to Obed-edom’s house?

answers: The ark’s presence was associated with blessing
The ark caused everyone to leave Israel
The ark was no longer important
challenge.explanation: The blessing follows the ark’s presence in Obed-edom’s house.
challenge.q: What may be understood from the blessing of Obed-edom’s house?

answers: It shows that reverent association with the ark was followed by blessing
It shows that the ark had no connection with worship
It shows that the journey ended in warfare
challenge.explanation: The final verse emphasizes the blessing received by Obed-edom’s household.
challenge.q: How does the ending develop the main idea of the passage?
